non_claim: This artifact records a real local custom-pack scan and executable policy boundaries. It does not claim a bundled-pack scan, dispatch, SARIF upload, or Advanced Security availability.

scan_population.bundled_lock_policy: Each canonical registry response is accepted only when its SHA-256 matches the checked-in lock; mutable p/* aliases are never passed directly to Semgrep.

policy.blocking_condition: A finding blocks only when its SARIF level is error and it is not an exact PR-target approved suppression, or when the Semgrep process exits nonzero for an execution or output error.
policy.bundled_findings: Bundled findings are counted separately by SARIF level; warning, note, and none are retained and reported but do not block.
policy.custom_findings: High-precision CoreLink rules R2/R3 declare explicit-error and block. R1/R4 are advisory duplicates of blocking Clippy lints because Semgrep OSS cannot reliably distinguish Rust code enclosed by colocated cfg(test) modules; their warnings remain retained and counted.
policy.suppression: Bundled pull_request_target ERRORs are nonblocking only when their in-source suppression is one exact coordinate returned by the PR-target guard; custom suppressions remain subject to the runbook nosemgrep reason and ADR convention; this policy does not broaden exclusions.
policy.semgrep_error_flag: not used; the evaluator applies the explicit SARIF ERROR policy and preserves nonzero scanner failures

sarif.advanced_security_unavailable: The scan remains authoritative locally and SARIF is retained as an artifact; upload is reported as unavailable_or_unverified unless the upload action explicitly succeeds.

custom_calibration_2026_09_09.decision: R1/R4 WARNING because measured findings are dominated by cfg(test) code and precise blocking is already enforced by Clippy; R2/R3 remain ERROR. R3 was converted from a non-matching Rust macro AST pattern to tokenized generic-mode patterns that distinguish strings/comments from Rust's struct-rest operator; it exposed 11 real test weaknesses, all repaired by payload assertions.

requires: A D03 bundle run with both SARIF populations and the generated report
No explicit ERROR findings, or remediation/approved suppression for every ERROR
Truthful upload outcome or retained artifact evidence when Advanced Security is unavailable
closure.owner_action: GitHub Advanced Security upload is a separate unavailable provider capability; retained local SARIF remains the evidence path and does not block repository calibration.
